ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Suspicious Change To Sensitive/Critical Files
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects changes of sensitive and critical files. Monitors files that you don't expect to change without planning on Linux system.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\/cat$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/echo$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/grep$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/head$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/more$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/tail$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\>.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\/emacs$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/nano$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/sed$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/vi$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/vim$"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/login.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/passwd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/boot\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/*\\\.conf.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/cron\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/crontab.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/hosts.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/init\\\.d.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/sudoers.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/opt\\/bin\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/sbin.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/usr\\/bin\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/usr\\/local\\/bin\\/.*"))
